title: Model-version cutover: migration runway, release notes, and GTM coordination
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Define and execute a low-friction cutover for retiring legacy model versions (v1.x->v3.x matrix) with coordinated release notes, migration guides, and targeted GTM comms. Scope includes API compatibility guidance, SDK migration flags, console UX banners, outbound outreach to high-usage customers, and rollback/fallback policies. Excludes model-retraining or new model architecture work (handled by Research).
acceptance_criteria: Public migration guide published and linked from API docs
Release notes for runtime-2.4 include clear developer action items and code snippets
Console rollout banner and migration checklist live in Canary for internal testing
High-touch customers (top 20 by usage) have scheduled migration calls or have accepted an automated migration plan
Abort/fallback play tested in staging: automatic routing to compatible variant within 30s
Telemetry dashboards show no more than 5% increase in error rate post-cutover during the first 72h
tasks: Finalize compatibility matrix mapping v1/v2 clients to v3 model variants (ENG)
Create SDK migration flags and one-line upgrade commands (SDK team)
Author step-by-step migration guide with code samples for Node/Python/Go (Docs)
Draft release notes with 'What changed', 'Action required', and 'Fallback options' sections (PM)
Design banners/tooltip copy for Console migration status and per-route flags (Design)
Prepare targeted outreach list and email templates for high-usage customers (Customer Success)
Schedule cross-team blackout window and emergency rollback contacts (Ops/ENG)
Create automated migration playbook script for non-breaking mapping where safe (Eng Reliability)
Prepare observability dashboard and SLO guardrails to monitor cutover impact (Observability)
Run one internal cutover rehearsal with canary release and postmortem notes (All teams)

communications_plan: Internal: Weekly syncs + Slack #version-cutover channel; all decision notes posted to Confluence (doc link: https://confluence.redwood/example-cutover)
Public release notes: top-of-page banner + changelog entry; pinned GitHub issue linking migration guide
Direct customer comms: Tiered emails + scheduled migration calls for top 20 customers; pre-built rollback script provided
Partner/Marketplace: Prepare listing updates and partner comms 2 weeks prior
Support playbook: Triage matrix, canned responses, and escalation path for engineering on-call
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Silent regressions in model outputs after mapping to v3 variants -> Mitigation: add regression test suite keyed to customer prompt sets and auto-alerts
Risk: Customers on pinned legacy versions can't migrate immediately -> Mitigation: offer dedicated reserved capacity on legacy for 6-12 weeks and clear SLA
Risk: Console UX confusion leads to config drift -> Mitigation: in-console migration checklist and one-click rollback per route
Risk: Release notes misunderstood by developers -> Mitigation: include copy-paste code upgrades and sample client diff snippets
